inherited_failure_boundary: The v0.33 utility-supervised selector preserved the frozen clean-performance safeguard but did not establish utility discrimination.
The v0.33 primary did not establish broad graded robustness under the frozen H5 criterion.
H1 target-signal adequacy and H2 selector learning were not adjudicable because required prospective evidence was not persisted at sufficient granularity.
The evidence does not identify target informativeness, selector optimization, calibration, evidence representation, or intervention mapping as the unique causal failure.
The favorable clean safeguard must not be discarded without prospective justification.

mandatory_observability_inheritance.principle: No formal run may begin unless every mechanism criterion required for later adjudication is prospectively persisted at its required population and conditioning granularity.
